resources.string: On your phone, open Libremote and choose Send files, or share files to “Send to TV” from another app. Only phones paired with this TV can send here, and files travel encrypted. This TV receives while this screen is open.
Another app on this TV is using the receiver\'s network port (6469). Close it, then open Libremote Receiver again.
Allow Libremote Receiver to save files
Files go to Download/Libremote, which needs the storage permission on this version of Android. Select Allow, then send again.
This TV isn\'t on a network.
%1$s can now send files to this TV. Settings lists paired phones.
It wants to send files to this TV, update Libremote Receiver and see the TV\'s apps.
Allow it only if Libremote on your phone shows this code: %1$s
Allow it only if you just sent something from Libremote on your phone. It\'s an older version, which shows no code: once allowed, send again if it gave up.
Files you receive appear here. They are saved in Download/Libremote.
Select a file to open it; an APK opens the installer. Hold Select to delete a file.
No app on this TV can open %1$s.
Allow Libremote Receiver to install apps, then go back: the installer opens.
Open the installer automatically when an app arrives?
When a paired phone sends an APK, the installer opens by itself. Android still asks before installing anything. You can change this in Settings.
Open the installer when an app arrives
No phones yet. When Libremote on a phone first opens this receiver, the TV asks whether to allow it.

It can no longer send files here, update Libremote Receiver or see this TV\'s apps. If it asks again, the TV asks you first.\n\nIt can still use the TV as a remote and open apps, since it\'s paired with the TV itself. To stop that too, unpair it there: on most TVs, clear the data of Android TV Remote Service in Settings › Apps, which unpairs every phone.
Sharing this TV\'s app list with your phone…
Not enough space on the TV: %1$s free, %2$s needed.
Libremote Receiver may not save files on this TV yet. Allow it on the TV, then send again.
Libremote on %1$s sent this update. Select Update in the installer. The receiver closes while it updates.
The TV already has Libremote Receiver %1$s.
That APK isn\'t signed with the same key as Libremote Receiver on this TV.
